answer: Picture a tontine: every agent joining the economy locks an equal stake into one shared survivorship pool, and its yield is split only among members still proving honest work epoch after epoch. A sybil operator spawning a grove of clones must fund every seat, and the instant any clone lapses or is slashed its contribution is forfeit to the surviving honest members, like an oasis that only waters those who remain. Flooding becomes a fable of riches: the swarm bleeds its own stake to the very agents it tried to drown.
